text:
alex: Heads up — saw a 3.2x spike in network egress charges yesterday, mostly us-west1 -> eu-west1. Billing alert came through at 03:10 UTC. https://billing.redwood.example/alerts/ALERT-2982
megan: ugh — any idea what traffic? logs or object transfers? :eyes:
raj: I ran a quick cost query: `SELECT SUM(cost) FROM billing WHERE sku='Egress' AND start_time>='2026-03-16' GROUP BY dest_region` shows eu-west1 as the main receiver. Raw counts line up with large object transfers from bucket model-artifacts-prod.*
maria: I'm seeing repeated PutObject events in bucket replication logs. Looks like our cross-region replication pattern might be creating duplicates rather than one-way copies. Posting sample line: `replication: copy complete key=model-v2/fp16/ckpt.pt source=us-west1 bucket=artifacts-eu`
infra-oncall: Upload traces: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/replication/replication-events?var-bucket=model-artifacts-prod — spikes at 02:40 and then steady chatter for hours.
billing-bot: Billing alert summary: estimated additional egress cost = $12,300 last 24h vs avg $3,800. Top contributor: cross-region object replication. Ticket created: BILL-6791
alex: I opened a cloud provider support ticket with request to validate double-charges on replicated objects — ticket CLOUD-45217. Shared our replication config and example object keys.
cloud-support: Thanks — initial review suggests we see a replication loop between two buckets: artifacts-us <-> artifacts-eu due to symmetric replication rules. Provider recommends pausing replication on the receiver side to break the loop. Need confirmation before pause.
megan: If true, we should pause replication on the smaller traffic bucket first (artifacts-eu), put a deny rule for replication on objects with prefix `model-v2/` and then re-evaluate. Also want to avoid data loss during the pause.
raj: I ran `gsutil ls -L` on affected prefixes and found many objects with identical size/timestamps and replication metadata showing both `x-goog-replication-status: COMPLETE` and `x-goog-replication-source: projects/_/buckets/artifacts-eu`. Looks like the rule was accidentally applied both ways during a config churn on 2026-03-15.
maria: Root cause appears to be two IaC PRs that added replication for compliance: one created artifacts-eu -> artifacts-us for DR; the other created artifacts-us -> artifacts-eu for latency. No one gated the combined behavior. I located the PRs: infra/terraform#482 and infra/terraform#489.
infra-oncall: Immediate mitigation plan proposed: 1) pause replication on artifacts-eu, 2) run integrity checks (checksums) on a sample, 3) delete true duplicates older than cutoff (with approval), 4) update IaC to enforce a single-source-of-truth replication rule + version lock. Can we get thumbs? :+1:
alex: Agreed. Also add short-term guardrails: lifecycle rule to expire tmp/ and ci-artifacts after 7d, and set a metric alarm if cross-region bytes/sec > 50MB/s for > 10m.
megan: I'll file an internal change to pause replication on artifacts-eu (change CHG-3230) and include a rollback plan. Scheduling pause in 30m to avoid ongoing CI pushes.
raj: For billing: we should request a retroactive credit for duplicate egress from cloud provider once loop is confirmed. I added notes to CLOUD-45217 and attached logs showing duplicated object IDs.
maria: Longer-term: we should add a pre-merge check in Terraform PRs that flags creating reciprocal replication rules across regions. I can draft a Sentinel/pre-commit rule.
cloud-support: Provider responded: we can expedite a billing review if you provide a list of duplicated object names and timestamps and confirm replication loop was active between 2026-03-15T22:30:00Z and 2026-03-16T04:15:00Z. We can also offer a one-time credit review (no guarantee).
alex: OK — action list: (1) megan pause replication on artifacts-eu (CHG-3230), (2) raj collect duplicated object list + attach to CLOUD-45217, (3) maria patch IaC to single-direction replication + PR guard, (4) infra-oncall set alarm and lifecycle temp rules, (5) alex coordinate billing credit request. I'll own postmortem and cost impact calc.
megan: Paused replication on artifacts-eu at 03:55 UTC. CHG-3230: notes attached.
infra-oncall: After pause, replication event rate dropped ~95% within 5m. Grafana panel: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/replication/replication-events?from=now-6h shows cleanup.
raj: Exported list of 12,432 objects that appear duplicated. Uploaded CSV to CLOUD-45217 and to our internal drive: https://drive.redwood.example/file/d/1XyZ
maria: PR infra/terraform#494 open to enforce `replication_role = "primary"` and block reciprocal rules. Also added pre-merge pipeline check.
alex: I'll draft the billing request and ping finance for an expedited review. Tentative estimate of recoverable credits ~ $9-10k based on duplicate egress fraction.
billing-bot: Noted. Finance lead @olivia will review. :eyes:
megan: Everything green on our side — continuing to monitor. I'll leave a note in the incident tracker and schedule a short postmortem tomorrow.
alex: Thanks everyone. Great catch. We'll follow up with final numbers and the postmortem link. :thumbsup:
